- `{name}` -> PARSE_RE matches `{name}`, split gives `['', '{name}', '']`, and `{name}` is handled correctly
- `{name` -> PARSE_RE doesn't match anything, split gives `['{name']`, which starts with `{` but isn't a valid field pattern
